summary: password_hash returns a password hash of a secret; available algorithms depend on the system and some restrict salts, such as bcrypt requiring a 22-character salt.
questions: How do I generate a hashed password for the user module?
Why does password_hash with bcrypt reject my salt?
Are all hash algorithms available for password_hash?

answer_card.title: password_hash filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ 'secret' | password_hash }}` returns a password hash. Available algorithms may be restricted by the system, and some restrict salt length or content; for example **Blowfish/bcrypt requires a 22-character salt**.
